name: ai-usage
description: Shows Claude Code and Codex usage limits in the status bar. Local, read-only, no dependencies.

aiUsage.intervalSeconds.description: How often to fetch usage while the window is focused. Also fetches when a limit resets and when the window regains focus.

aiUsage.timeZone.markdownDescription: IANA time zone for the times shown, e.g. `Asia/Tehran` or `America/Edmonton`. Empty uses the system time zone. Budget days follow the weekly window, so this changes only how times are displayed.
